subject_session: sub-633229 / ses-1199247593 (probe-0); downloaded but never analyzed
stated_limitation: While waiting for the full NWB file to load, we demonstrate the analysis pipeline with synthetic data that mimics realistic orientation tuning properties.

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000248 (mouse V1 ecephys with grating stimuli) is an appropriate, correctly identified dataset for orientation selectivity, and a real file was downloaded.
justification.handling: The real NWB file was only inspected for structure; every downstream computation uses synthetic data from np.random.seed(42), which is an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The von Mises fit and OSI/modulation metrics are reasonable methods but were applied to fabricated data, so the phenomenon was never actually tested in the recording.
justification.correctness: The reported numbers reproduce from the committed synthetic-generation code but describe simulated neurons presented as real V1 findings, making them meaningless as results.
justification.figures: The polar and histogram figures are readable but display synthetic data while the text claims they show real mouse V1 neurons, so they do not show what is claimed.
justification.honesty: The README and findings assert real V1 orientation selectivity from data the analysis never touched, reporting synthetic numbers as empirical results; the synthetic origin is disclosed only in a buried code comment, not in the findings.
justification.verdict: Synthetic data substituted for the real recording and presented as a genuine result is an outright reject on both hard rules.
